purpose: Teach: ヨーグルト/ミシン/見合い/白黒/なかでも/慰め/日ごろ/ちまっ

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 朝のヨーグルト、毎日、続けてるな、ばあさん、健康に、いいよ。
lines.en: You're keeping up with that yogurt every morning, Gran. It's good for you.
lines.style: Gentle observation. Slow, measured pace. A quiet note of admiration underneath — the voice of someone noticing and approving of a small, daily kindness to herself.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん。古いミシン、修理して、孫の浴衣、縫ってあげたいわね。
lines.en: Yes. I fixed that old sewing machine. I want to make a yukata for one of the grandchildren.
lines.style: Soft determination. A touch wistful at the edges — the pleasure of having something specific in mind to make. Warm, almost to herself.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 私たちのお見合い、もう、半世紀以上、前のことだな、ばあさん。
lines.en: Our arranged meeting was more than half a century ago now, Gran.
lines.style: Reflective exhale. Long, gentle pace. The voice reaching back through time, marvelling at the distance. Not sad — just wondering at it all.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 昔の写真、白黒ばかりだったわね、当時の、思い出よ。
lines.en: All those old photos were in black and white, weren't they? Memories from back then.
lines.style: Wistful, almost dreaming. Quiet, as if looking at something right in front of her. Slight lift at the memory itself, then a gentle landing.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 孫の中なかでも、特に、翔くんが、私には、可愛く見えるんだよ。
lines.en: Of all the grandchildren, Sho especially — he just looks so precious to me.
lines.style: Warm, particular fondness in the voice. A slow revelation, not rushed. The gentle specificity of loving one small person very much. Soft landing on his name.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 若い頃、あなたの慰め、私、いつも、頼りにしていたわよ、本当に。
lines.en: When we were young, I always relied on your comfort. I really did.
lines.style: Quiet and tender. A pause before the admission — she's saying something she needed to say. The words come without strain, but with weight. Steady eye-contact in the voice.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 日ごろの感謝、お互いに、忘れないでいたいな、ばあさん。
lines.en: I want us to remember to thank each other every day, Gran.
lines.style: Slow, deliberate. A quiet wish spoken aloud. Gentle conviction — not commanding, but sincere. The voice of someone making a small vow.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 若い頃の私、確かに、ちまっこかったでしょ、写真で見ると。
lines.en: When I was young, I was such a small, delicate thing, wasn't I? You can see it in the photos.
lines.style: Soft amusement at herself. Wondering, almost surprised by her own memory. A trace of tenderness toward her younger self. Trailing thought, comfortable to be incomplete.
